title: Breaking Change: AssistAnswer's `connectorDisplayNames` is now Read-Only
summary: The `connectorDisplayNames` property in both `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1alphaAssistAnswer` and `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1betaAssistAnswer` schemas has been made read-only. This is a breaking change for applications that may have been writing to this field.
details: The `connectorDisplayNames` property within the `AssistAnswer` schema (for both `v1alpha` and `v1beta` versions) is now explicitly marked as `readOnly`. This field provides a mapping from internal connector agent names to their human-readable display names, intended for output-only use in user interfaces. If your application was previously attempting to write to this field, you will need to update your code to reflect its new immutable status.
